text:
maria: heads-up — main CI red after latest poetry lock regen from @depsbot (PR #4123). Failing integration: tests/auth/test_token_refresh.py::test_concurrent_refresh — AssertionError in token compare. logs attached.
ci-bot: build #987 failed on linux-latest (job: integration-ubuntu).
josh: I'll kick a rerun on the red job.
linh: seen flaky token refresh before when our network mock changed shape. can you paste the failing trace?
maria: here — ```
E   AssertionError: 123 != 456
tests/auth/test_token_refresh.py:42: AssertionError
  File "/workspace/app/auth/token.py", line 88, in refresh
    data = serializer.loads(msg)
  File "/venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/msgpack/_unpacker.py", line 123, in loads
    raise ValueError('invalid code')
```
josh: rerun started...
josh: rerun finished — one matrix job still red (integration-py310-ubuntu). others green.
linh: that smells like a transitive dep bump from the lock regen. which packages changed? @depsbot can you paste the lock diff?
depsbot: diff: +aiokafka 3.0.0, -aiokafka 2.1.0; +kafka-python 2.0.0, -kafka-python 1.1.0; rest unchanged. link: https://repolink/lock-diff/4123
sam: aiokafka 3.x had some serializer changes in 3.0 release notes — I think default msgpack handling switched to `use_bin_type=True` and changed bytes/str semantics.
linh: confirmed locally: with aiokafka 3.0 our serializer (which expects raw bytes) now gets a str and msgpack.loads raises. tests assume bytes.
maria: can we pin aiokafka to 2.1.x as a quick fix?
josh: quick bisect plan: checkout commit before lock regen, run `poetry install` (from that lock), run failing test, then apply regen commit (poetry.lock updated) and run again. I can run locally to confirm culprit.
maria: created a temporary revert PR to restore previous lock for CI stability while we triage. PR: https://repolink/pr/4135 (wip)
josh: reproducing now locally...
josh: reproduced — fail appears only when aiokafka==3.0.0 is installed.
linh: OK that's the culprit. short-term fix options: (1) pin aiokafka to ^2.1.0 in pyproject and re-run lock, (2) adjust our serializer to handle bytes/str dual modes, or (3) ask the transitive upstream (kafka-python) to pin aiokafka.
sam: I'd prefer (1) + follow-up (2) — pin to keep CI green, add unit test and a small patch to serializer to be tolerant of str.
maria: @josh can you open a PR that adds `aiokafka = "^2.1.0"` to pyproject and regenerates lock (or simply edits lock + run `poetry lock`)? I'll attach the failing test trace and link to this thread.
josh: will do. also tagging @deps-team to check why deps bot allowed major bump in regen. :eyes:
linh: follow-up: add a regression test in tests/unit/serializer_test.py for msgpack bytes vs str handling. that should catch future transitive bumps.
maria: thanks — once PR merges I'll rerun full main CI and monitor. marking this as blocker for the release branch. :white_check_mark:
sam: extra note: put a short note in the regen checklist to `grep` for aiokafka/kafka changes before merging lock regen PRs. saved us a couple hours.
maria: agreed. closing the triage for now — will re-open if rerun shows more failures. :+1:
